label: Start a fix from your remember list
phrases: fix the thing on my remember list tonight
do the thing on my remember list
sort out the one on my remembered list tonight
take care of the thing from my remember list
match: ^(please |can you |could you |would you )?(fix|do|sort( out)?|handle|tackle|take care of|work on)\b.{0,40}\b(on|from|in|off) (my|the) remember(ed)? list\b
message: Started. It will wait for your go.
